How to read this report
Group status
Operational — All checks passing, sensors healthy.
Deteriorated — Checks pass but sensor health is below 80%.
Feed issue — One or more API checks are failing.
Traffic Detection sensor statuses
Working — Sensor reported a positive speed; vehicles detected, hardware OK.
No traffic — Sensor is communicating but reported speed = 0; no vehicles detected.
Malfunctioning — Sensor reported speed = -1, the hardware fault code; loop detector likely damaged.
No measurement — Sensor is in the inventory but sent no data this run.
VMS statuses
Working — Controller is active and responding correctly.
Not working — Controller explicitly reported a fault; sign may be offline or damaged.
No status — Controller exists in the system but sent no status in this run.
Bluetooth Path statuses
Working — Path has valid speed and travel time data.
Failing — No speed or travel time reported; no vehicles detected on route or Bluetooth readers lost connectivity.
Sensor stability panel
Each row shows a sensor's last 20 checks as coloured bars — green = good, red = fault, grey = no data or no traffic. Hover over a bar to see the exact timestamp and status.
The health badge (e.g. Healthy 95%) shows the percentage of all recorded checks that returned a good status since monitoring began. Click any row to expand a daily trend chart.
